newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end amid bearish senitment.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end amid bearish senitment.

text.p: Pakistani stocks plunged 2.08 percent on Sunday amid a heavy selling pressure on what dealers called presistant confusion about the impact of proposed reforms likely to be unveiled in mid-December.
"Lack of clarity about the government's plan of action on economic front is restricting investors from taking long-term positions," dealer Salman Ahmed of Finex Securities said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 31.38 points to close at 1,480.48. Losers led gainers 144 to 87.
Pakistan State Oil fell 6.0 rupees to 388 and Fauji Fertilizer 5.50 to 79. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
